# Sunstone House

> Furnished monthly rooms in a shared co-living house in Kenton, North Portland, Oregon (97217). Ten private furnished rooms across two units. Month-to-month with a 31-day minimum stay, utilities included, no deposit on private contracts through RentRedi. No pets, no smoking.

## All rooms (monthly rent, utilities included; availability as of October 29, 2026)

- Opal (Unit A2) — $1,300/mo, queen bed, 160 sq ft, floor 2 — open now
- Sapphire (Unit C1) — $1,350/mo, queen bed, 220 sq ft, floor 2 — open now
- Azurite (Unit C6) — $1,100/mo, single bed, floor 2 — open now
- Kunzite (Unit C5) — $1,100/mo, twin bed, petite room — open now
- Emerald (Unit C2) — $1,300/mo, queen bed, 198 sq ft, floor 2, A/C — booked through November 8, 2026; opens November 9
- Garnet (Unit A4) — $1,100/mo, twin bed, A/C — booked through November 30, 2026; opens December 1
- Coral (Unit A1) — private contract, month-to-month — pricing on request
- Lapis (Unit C4) — private contract, month-to-month — pricing on request
- Apatite (Unit A5) — private contract, month-to-month — pricing on request
- Pyrite (Unit C3) — private contract, month-to-month — pricing on request

Availability changes as reservations change; the room cards on the website carry the current reservation end dates.

## House facts

- Shared kitchen, shared baths, in-house washer/dryer (coin-free, detergent supplied), housekeeping, on-site management
- Terms: month-to-month, 31-day minimum, utilities built into rent, no deposit (tenants are responsible for any damage), no pets, no smoking
- Quiet hours: 10 pm to 7 am. Business hours: 8 am to 5 pm
- Guests bring clothes, food, and a laptop — rooms are fully furnished
